description: Six weeks of simulated historical actuals (demand, schedules, callouts, availability, service). Use to learn patterns and the staffing-service relationship.

Expected conditions for the planning week Thu 2026-02-12 to Wed 2026-02-18. The calendar already contains Valentines Day (Sat) and Presidents Day (Mon); teams must forecast those effects themselves. Demand multiplier = 1.00.

Baseline plus a member Instant Savings promotion launch on Fri 2026-02-13 and a winter-storm advisory that triggers stock-up trips Fri-Sat. Apply the demand multipliers to your BASE forecast. Availability is unchanged from BASE.
Baseline demand, but an illness cluster at Warehouse 2 (Feb 13-16) and a short receiving crew at Warehouse 4 (Feb 12-13) reduce available employees and overtime capacity.
